query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.hit_count score, r.ref, r.resource_type, r.has_image, r.is_transcoding, r.creation_date, r.rating, r.user_rating, r.user_rating_count, r.user_rating_total, r.file_extension, r.preview_extension, r.image_red, r.image_green, r.image_blue, r.thumb_width, r.thumb_height, r.archive, r.access, r.colour_key, r.created_by, r.file_modified, r.file_checksum, r.request_count, r.new_hit_count, r.expiry_notification_sent, r.preview_tweaks, r.file_path, r.modified, r.file_size , null group_access, null user_access , r.access resultant_access , r.field12 , r.field8 , r.field3 , rty.order_by , r.hit_count total_hit_count FROM resource r JOIN resource_type AS rty ON r.resource_type = rty.ref  WHERE archive IN (?) AND r.ref>0 GROUP BY r.ref, user_access, group_access ) AS count_select
